title: MFA enforcement — control effectiveness
summary: Share of detection firings that occur against principals attesting compliance with the MFA-enforcement control. Drops when principals regress out of MFA (legacy-auth exceptions, conditional-access bypass), exposing the playbook to credential-access blind spots. Higher is better.

target.rationale: Below 0.9 indicates MFA-enforcement drift on protected principals.

measurement.formula: count(detection firings on principals attesting control compliant) / count(detection firings) over window.

inputs.name: attested
inputs.description: principal attestation state for MFA enforcement

external_refs.name: NIS2 Directive Article 21(2)(d) — identity management and authentication
DORA Regulation Article 17 — ICT-related incident management
